evidencePolicy: Every added source record stores its official website, the exact official verification URL, verification date, service/category evidence, and explicit location or service-area evidence. Missing contact fields remain omitted.
researchNotes: Existing cached Foursquare artifacts were inspected first; none supplied a usable additional candidate for the targeted Grayton Beach gaps.
No paid API request was made.
Google Maps, Google Places, Yelp, and Angi were not used as sources.
Gulf Coast Roadside Assistance and Panama City Roadside share phone 850-328-3898 and were treated as one identity, not two listings.
Existing business identities and canonical websites were retained when extending verified service areas.
